steps.title: What is First Aid?
steps.content:
First aid is the immediate help given before professionals arrive.

Goals:
• Save life
• Prevent worsening
• Promote recovery

steps.title: What is the main purpose of first aid?
steps.correctExplanation: First aid provides immediate care before professionals arrive.
steps.incorrectExplanation: First aid is not meant to replace doctors or perform surgery.

steps.title: Which is NOT a goal of first aid?
steps.correctExplanation: Surgery is not part of first aid.
steps.incorrectExplanation: Saving life and preventing worsening are core goals.

steps.title: Arrange first aid priorities
steps.correctExplanation: Correct order: save life → prevent worsening → promote recovery.
steps.incorrectExplanation: Life-threatening issues must always come first.

steps.title: Why is early recognition important?
steps.correctExplanation: Recognizing problems early allows faster and correct action.
